Canvas: Living room — the catch (scene_livingroom_catch) | Node: Living room — the catch



[IMAGE MISSING] scenes/scene_livingroom_catch.jpg

Living room late evening. Maya on the couch under a blanket, phone in one hand showing something flushed-looking, her other hand under the blanket. TV on low. Her cheeks flushed. Frank in the doorway, key still in his hand, frozen.

You thought he was already in bed. The TV's on low. Your phone's open to something you shouldn't be watching with the door open, the blanket over your lap, your other hand not on the phone.

You don't hear his step in the hall until the floorboard creaks at the doorway.

Frank's in the doorway, key still in his hand from the back door. He doesn't move. He sees the phone screen. He sees the blanket. He sees the way your hand is moving under it. He sees you see him.

Frank: Girl.
Don't move.









Sit there in the dark.
